_comment: Placeholder vocabulary. Copy this file to internal_terms.json and replace
the values with your organisation's own terms — that copy is gitignored.
A term here means: a word that appears in the internal wiki and nowhere in
public documentation. Matching one force-includes the Confluence index in
routing, regardless of what the LLM decided.
products   — internal platform / product names. Matched as substrings.
acronyms   — internal abbreviations. Matched with ASCII word boundaries so
a short one does not fire inside an unrelated English word.
locations  — offices or sites. CJK terms need no boundary.
